 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-eef53f7f.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The frame/background is the most frequent color.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    source = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    if not zeros or not source:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    zr0, zr1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    zc0, zc1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in source), max(r for r, c in source)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in source), max(c for r, c in source)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(zr1 - zr0 + 1):
        for dc in range(zc1 - zc0 + 1):
            out[zr0 + dr][zc0 + dc] = grid[sr0 + dr][sc1 - dc]
    return out
"
}
